title: Composition with a dilation preserves test forms on ℝ^P
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, a ∈ ℝ^P (Euclid P) and λ > 0, and let η := dilation a λ, η(y) = −λ⁻¹a + λ⁻¹y. For every test m-form φ on ℝ^P, there is a test m-form φ' on ℝ^P with φ'(y) = φ(η(y)) for every y ∈ ℝ^P. Here a test m-form on ℝ^P is an element of TestFormOn univ m: a C^∞ map ℝ^P → Λ^m(ℝ^P) with compact support.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (a : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → ∀ φ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, ∃ φ' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, ∀ y : Euclid P, (φ' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) y = (φ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (dilation a lam y)
